retained_container_retired_by_the_produc.how: start the product's own rootless docker unit, then call the PINNED A0 runtime (host_runtime.a0_runtime_module -> frw_pinned_a0_runtime) with Runtime(plan, stopping=True).retire_initial_probe() for the exact recorded plan
retained_container_retired_by_the_produc.why_this_order: the installed A0 runtime stops the daemon BEFORE it retires the container, so the `docker rm` ACK is unobtainable in the ordinary stop path; with the daemon alive the product's own retirement succeeds

a0_runtime_defects_reproduced_factly.defect: retirement happens after the daemon is stopped
a0_runtime_defects_reproduced_factly.evidence: a0_bootstrap.stop() calls runtime.stop() (which stops the container AND the daemon unit) and only afterwards retire_initial_probe() (docker rm through the daemon socket); the socket is gone by then, so the retirement ACK is impossible
a0_runtime_defects_reproduced_factly.symptom_seen: sol dir 1aa21b1f.../retirement.json absent, bootstrap phase STOP_UNCONFIRMED
a0_runtime_defects_reproduced_factly.workaround_available: yes - the product's own retirement succeeds when the daemon is alive (used twice, see major_progress)

a0_runtime_defects_reproduced_factly.evidence: a0_bootstrap.stop() execs the recorded copy of a0_runtime.py (sha 69bcda79...) as a fresh module; that copy imports `plugins.friday_rework.supervision` as a package, but only hermes-agent/plugins is a package - worker-runtime-source/plugins/friday_rework holds only adapters/a0_profile.py and a0_web.py. host_runtime.a0_runtime_module installs a scoped_import for the live module only

a0_runtime_defects_reproduced_factly.defect: the native worker unit's RuntimeMaxSec (120 s) is shorter than the qualification window (300 s)
a0_runtime_defects_reproduced_factly.evidence: adapters/a0_native.py _exec(): timeout = min(timeout, native_left - 1, deadline - now - 5), native_left = ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic + RuntimeMaxUSec - now; friday-rework-docker.service has RuntimeMaxSec=120s, so the exec budget is exhausted as soon as the daemon has been up for a while
a0_runtime_defects_reproduced_factly.symptom_seen: RuntimeErrorBoundary: budget_exhausted on the third owner attempt
